card.name: Digits inside years and decimal doses
card.fires_on: The digit 4 or 1 in the middle of a year like 1947 or 1810, and the decimal point in a dose like 0.6 or 0.3 mg. It fires partway through a number, before the rest of it is written.

modes.label: Decimal point in a dose
modes.description: The point after 0 in a colchicine-style follow-up dose such as 0.6 mg or 0.3 mg.
modes.example: followed by 0<<.>>6 mg (one tablet) one hour

card.writes: It suppresses the word "before" and its translations, so it pushes against a "before" next.
card.plain: It marks the middle of a year or a small decimal dose, where the number is not yet finished and a word like "before" would not fit.
